Proposition
[rigidity of shrinking breathers] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Proposition 12.18\group Kleiner–Lott Entropy Functionals A shrinking breather is a gradient shrinking soliton.
Proof

\sketch Set $t_0=(t_2-ct_1)/(1-c)$ and $\tau _i=t_0-t_i$, so $\tau _2=c\tau _1$. Scale and diffeomorphism invariance give

\begin{equation} \mu (g(t_2),\tau _2)=\mu ((\tau _2/\tau _1)\phi ^*g(t_1),\tau _2)=\mu (g(t_1),\tau _1), \end{equation}

so equality holds in the monotonicity formula.

□
